description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fast food chain specializing in fresh, hand-cut and hand-breaded chicken, with nearly 300 locations across Canada including this Chilliwack stop on South Fraser Way. The chain prides itself on whole, Canada Grade A chicken marinated and cooked fresh in-store rather than pressure-fried, making it a recognizable comfort-food option for cyclists passing through. Takeout is available, and drive-thru and delivery options may also be offered at this location.
